assessments.reasoning: AGPL [28300,28957) connects the additional GPLv3 source to the source covered by the preceding offer and specifies incorporation under the following paragraph. This defeats both omission of qualifying GPLv3 source and unconditional inclusion of nearby software.
AGPL [28959,29400) supplies the referenced route into one combined work and preserves GPLv3 on its part. Mere co-deployment and a GPLv2-only work each fail a distinct condition of that route.

AGPL [5264,6955) defines what source corresponds to a work. It includes necessary build and installation scripts and can reach specifically required libraries, while excluding qualifying System Libraries and certain unmodified tools. Those boundaries defeat an all-files-on-the-host reading. Section 13 supplies the specific rule including the incorporated GPLv3 work's Corresponding Source.

limitations: The scope of each work's Corresponding Source is governed by §1. Component inventories or deployment locations alone cannot establish incorporation.
reasoning: When the AGPLv3 §13 network offer is due, paragraph 1 expressly includes the Corresponding Source of each GPLv3 work incorporated through paragraph 2. Two conditions matter independently: the licensee's modified version supports remote network interaction and has interacting remote users to whom the offer is due, and the GPLv3 work is incorporated into one combined work through the specified route.
